verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a template API: no endpoints to create or update templates, no versioning, and no sending by template id with variable payloads. React Email (resend-docs-10) is a code-side building block for rendering HTML before sending, not a stored-template API. The changelog mention of 'Templates' (resend-docs-17) only shows a templates feature exists, without any API management or send-by-id capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, version, and update email templates through the API and trigger sends by template id with variable payloads
